statement: The two stage close declared in the close plan, executed and recorded. The acceptance record of the block is not rewritten; this record stands beside it.

owner_finding_correction.original_finding: Both closing checks aggregated over an empty set during the acceptance run and still entered the overall pass.
owner_finding_correction.correction: Confirmed for mf-evidence, refuted for mf-phase-results. The withdrawal probe made mf-phase-results fail with phase_result_missing, so it really consumes the four phase results; its empty detail list was the issue list, not the aggregated set. mf-evidence verified zero raw logs for the phase with the withdrawn result and still reported evidence_complete — that is the defect rule R10 was written for.
owner_finding_correction.note: Recorded at the owner's instruction: a corrected finding is worth more than a confirmed one.

activation.expectation_discipline: The value handed to the owner was derived from the acceptance commit, twice independently, and the package was proven unchanged between the acceptance commit and the position 4 commit: no diff over tools/guard and tools/guardpkg, and the derivation yields the same digest at both commits. The hash that had been derived at the earlier normative commit was not passed on.
activation.verified_after: The installed package digest was re-derived from the installation and equals the expectation value; active.json names the acceptance commit.

explicit_checks_after_activation: scripts/guard-collect.sh status answers with guard_source active and guard_version 1.3.0 instead of refusing; exit 0; wrote_anything false.

scripts/guard-collect.sh verify over the owner evidence area, spoken by the active guard: both historical objects structurally sound, classification version_mismatch with expired also applying, integrity and command digests re-derived, no findings.
The gate mode collect-tool passed in both stages.
termination: As declared in the close plan: this commit adds records only, changes no behaviour, and certifies nothing about itself. No phase is re-run against it. A later reader verifies the close by re-running against the position 4 commit.
